chore(release): set `package.json` to 1.232.3

## [1.232.3](https://github.com/promptctl/cc-candybar/compare/v1.232.2...v1.232.3) (2026-11-18)

### Bug Fixes

* **update-act:** an overdue act whose files a newer act pruned still has its proven group ended (pj1z) ([#806](https://github.com/promptctl/cc-candybar/issues/806)) ([23b2de0](https://github.com/promptctl/cc-candybar/commit/23b2de009c29760ad28d0fb6368579b0eeea19ef))
* **watchers:** a path watched by name is polled at its path, and only folders ride the OS event stream (iywk) ([#805](https://github.com/promptctl/cc-candybar/issues/805)) ([5562879](https://github.com/promptctl/cc-candybar/commit/556287991e7955f7a9fbfc4a12b9ded691a25344))

fix(git): a git or forge read unsets the repository variables of the shell that spawned the daemon (a623)

Every git read, forge CLI launch and the doctor's forge probe now launch
through one asker that unsets the variables `git rev-parse
--local-env-vars` names, asked of git once. The daemon's environment is
the spawning shell's, so a hook's or vcsh's GIT_DIR pointed every
session's read at that shell's repository. An ask that fails is the
read's own failed launch, never a read with the variables.

fix(storage): a storage folder's watch or stat fault clears when the OS answers again (tvhj)

A refused or erroring watch, or a folder a judgment could not stat, no
longer ends its generation. The fault is derived from the handle's
deafness (taken at each window and at open, when the registry tells a
move of it) and the last judgment's stat, so the registry's period
reopen and the next judgment clear it in place. A start or change of a
fault is counted and logged once; a clear is logged. Only a folder that
could not be made stays terminal.
fix(test): the quiet-text sweep draws each row under the theme it names (s33)
fix(edit): a click releases every state key its change of the config ends, so a re-added placement's library opens closed (t2yz)
fix(daemon): a connection is one state, reads one frame, and answers an unencodable reply (df7i)
fix(doctor): the config row names the repository the bar asks about, and where it stands (qo8j)
